requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The charge, worded exactly as the court record words it, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The charge, worded exactly as the court record words it, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the charge, worded exactly as the court record words it - it must be a violation of NRS 200.485, NRS 484C.110 or NRS 484C.120 for this petition to be the right instrument

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The district, justice or municipal court that handled the case, and its county, in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The district, justice or municipal court that handled the case, and its county, in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: venue follows the court of the underlying case, which lives on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court that handled the case - district, justice or municipal - and its county, copied from your own court paperwork; that court's clerk can confirm it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The chapter 176A programme the case ran under, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The chapter 176A programme the case ran under, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which programme section applies is a case fact on the court's own record, not a fact the platform holds
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which programme your case ran under - alcohol or other substance use (NRS 176A.240), mental illness or intellectual disabilities (NRS 176A.260), or veterans and members of the military (NRS 176A.290) - the clerk of the court that handled the case can tell you from the record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the conditional dismissal or of the setting aside of the judgment, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the conditional dismissal or of the setting aside of the judgment, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the conditional dismissal or set-aside, from your court paperwork - the seven-year period runs from it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the charge was resolved - conditionally dismissed, or the judgment set aside - in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the charge was resolved - conditionally dismissed, or the judgment set aside - in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the resolution kind decides the branch and lives on the record, not in the platform
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether the charges were conditionally dismissed or the judgment of conviction was set aside, exactly as the record states it - if the record is unclear, stop and ask the clerk of the court that handled the case

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the underlying case, in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the underlying case, in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the underlying case, copied from your court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Agencies and officers whose records are sealed by this order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Agencies and officers whose records are sealed by this order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which agencies touched the particular case is operative text the participant establishes from their own papers
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: every agency and officer that touched your case - the sections reach only records in the custody of the agencies and officers named in the court's order, so an agency left off the list keeps its records unsealed; your own papers name them, and the clerk of the court that handled the case can help you check the list

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same case number as the petition, from your court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The court named in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The court named in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: venue follows the court of the underlying case
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same court as the petition, copied from your court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The chapter 176A programme stated in paragraph 2 of the declaration
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The chapter 176A programme stated in paragraph 2 of the declaration
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which programme section applies is a case fact on the court's own record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the programme your case ran under, the same answer as on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The resolution and its date stated in paragraph 3 of the declaration
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The resolution and its date stated in paragraph 3 of the declaration
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the charge was resolved and on what date, the same answers as on the petition, from your court paperwork
